Ix yalan winh icha tik: Ha t'a junok chiwajum, hata' ix elta tas tz'uk'chaji. Ha t'a jun te ay yip, hata' ix elta tas te chi', xchi winh. Haxo t'a yoxil k'ual q'uinh chi', maj yal-laj spakan jun lolonel chi' heb' winh kelemtak chi'.

Yuj chi' haxo t'a schanhil k'ual, ix yalan heb' winh t'a ix yetb'eyum winhaj Sansón chi' icha tik: --Montej ab' t'a winh etb'eyum chi' tas syalelk'och jun lolonel ix yal winh t'ayonh, slajwi chi' tzalan t'ayonh. Tato maay, ol ach ko nhustz'a yet' a mam a nun yet' masanil mach ayek' t'a yol a pat tik. Ichato tonhej tzonh eyawtejkot t'a tik, yik tze k'ananek' tas ay t'ayonh, xchi heb' winh t'a ix.

Ixlajwi chi', wan yok' ix, ix b'at yalan ix t'a winhaj Sansón chi': --Tzin a chak a ach tik. Max in a xajanejlaj. Ix al jun a lolonel yik snael heb' winh wetchonhab', palta manh wal jab'ok tzal t'ayin tas syalelk'ochi, xchi ix t'a winh. Ix tak'wi winh t'a ix icha tik: --Max waltax t'a in mam in nun, atob' wal t'ayach ol wala', xchi winh.
Ix och wal ijan ix yok' t'a winh t'a uke' k'ual chi', yuj chi' haxo t'a yukil k'ual chi', ix yalan winh t'a ix tas syalelk'ochi. Ixnhej lajwi yab'an ix, ix b'at yalan ix t'a heb' yetchonhab' chi'.

Haxo t'a k'ik'b'alil t'a yukil k'ual chi', ix b'at yalan heb' winh t'a winhaj Sansón chi' icha tik: Malaj junokxo tas te chi' t'a yichanh nok' yalchab'. Malaj pax junokxo te ay yip t'a yichanh nok' choj, xchi heb' winh. Ix tak'wi winh icha tik: Yujnhej to ix he montej eyab' t'a ix wetb'eyum tik, yuj chi' ix nachaj eyalan tas syalelk'ochi, xchi winh.

Ixlajwi chi' ix ochxi Yespíritu Jehová t'a winh, ix te och yip winh. Ix b'at winh t'a chonhab' Ascalón, ix b'at smak'ancham 30 heb' winh filisteo winh ta'. Ha spichul heb' winh ayochi, a ix yik'elta winh, ix yak'an winh stojolok tas ix yal chi'. Ixlajwi chi', wan ste chichon sk'ol winh ix meltzaj winh t'a spat winh smam.
Haxo ix yetb'eyum winh chi', ha t'a jun winh ajun yet' winh t'a jun q'uinh chi', ha t'a winh ix ak'ji ix.

Ix ek' jab'xo tiempo, ix b'atxi winhaj Sansón chi' yil ix yetb'eyum chi' yalani, yet'nak jun nok' yune' chiwa winh. Ha t'a jun pekti' chi' wanxo syamchajoch sjochchaj ixim trigo. Haxo ix k'och winh, ix yalan winh t'a winh snhi' icha tik: --Tzin nib'ej tzin och wil ix wetb'eyum t'a yol skuarto, xchi winh. Majxo chajiochlaj winh yuj winh snhi' chi'.

Anhej to ix yal winh t'a winh icha tik: --Ha in naani to manhxalaj a gana t'a ix, yuj chi' ix wak' ix t'a jun winh ajun het'ok t'a q'uinh chi'. Palta ay wal junxo ix snulej ix tzak'anto t'ay, te ek'b'alto swach'il yilji ix t'a yichanh ix etb'eyum chi', syal a ix tzik'b'ati, xchi winh snhi' winh chi'.
Ix tak'wi winh t'a winh snhi' chi' icha tik: --Ha tiknaik jun, max yal-laj skotkan t'a wib'anh yuj tas ol wutok heb' etchonhab' tik yuj in pakan in b'a, xchi winh.
Ix b'at winh b'ian, ix b'at syamankot 300 nok' waax winh, ix stzek'anoch junjun tob'an te taj winh t'a snhe chatakwanh nok'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'anoch sk'ak'al te' winh, ix yaktanb'at nok' winh t'a skal ixim strigo heb' winh filisteo chi'. Masanil ixim kunhkunhb'axo yaj sjochchaji yet' ixim aytooch t'a yok ix tz'ab'ati. Ix tz'apaxb'at te' uwa yet' te' oliwo.

Ix och ijan heb' filisteo sk'anb'aneq'ui mach ix k'ulan jun chi'. Ix alchaj t'a heb' to a winhaj Sansón, yujto ix chichon sk'ol winh yuj tas ix utaj yuj winh snhi', winh aj Timnat, to ix ik'jiek' ix yetb'eyum winh, ix ak'ji ix t'a jun winh ajun yet' winh t'a q'uinh yik snupnajel. Yuj chi' ix jawi heb' filisteo snhusantz'a ix ix chi' yet' smam.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winhaj Sansón chi' icha tik: --Yujto icha tik ix he k'ulej, yuj chi' manh ol in och waan ex wixtani, masanto ol wak'kanek' in pak t'ayex, xchi winh.
Ix kot wal yowal winh sik'lab'il, yuj chi' tzijtum anima ix smak'cham winh. Ixlajwi chi' ix b'at kajnaj winh t'a k'een nhak'een t'a Etam.
Ix jawi heb' winh filisteo sb'ok'e skampamento t'a yol yik Judá t'a slak'anil Lehi.

Ix sk'anb'an heb' winh aj Judá chi' t'a heb' winh: --¿Tas yuj tzex jawi eyak' owal ket'ok? xchi heb' winh. Ix tak'wi heb' winh filisteo chi': --Ha winhaj Sansón tzul ko yama', ol kak'anoch syaelal winh, yujto niwan chukal ix yak' winh t'ayonh, xchi heb' winh.

Ayik ix yab'an jun chi' heb' winh aj Judá chi', oxe' mil heb' winh ix b'at ilan winhaj Sansón t'a k'een nhak'een t'a Etam chi', ix yalan heb' winh t'a winh: --¿Tom manh ojtakok to ayonh och t'a yol sk'ab' heb' winh filisteo tik? ¿Tas yuj tzak'och chukal t'a ko kal yet' heb' winh? xchi heb' winh t'a winh. Ix tak'wi winh t'a heb' winh: --Icha in yutej heb' winh, icha pax ix wutej heb' winh, xchi winh.

Ix yalan heb' winh t'a winh icha tik: --Yuj chi' to tzul ach ko tzek'b'at tiknaik yik b'at ach kak'an t'a heb' winh chi', xchi heb' winh. Ix tak'wi winh t'a heb' winh: --Hak'ek he ti' t'ayin an, tato yel manh ol in he milchamlaj, xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi heb' winh t'a winh icha tik: --Maay, manh ol ach ko milchamlaj, anhej to ol ach ko tzek'b'ati, b'at ach kak'an t'a heb' winh filisteo chi', xchi heb' winh. Ixlajwi chi', ix stzek'an winh heb' winh t'a chab' ch'anh lasu te ak'to, ix yik'anelta winh heb' winh t'a yol k'een nhak'een chi'.

Haxo ix k'och heb' winh t'a Lehi chi', ix kot heb' winh filisteo scha heb' winh, toxonhej tz'awaj heb' winh yuj tzalajk'olal. Elanhchamel ix ochxi Yespíritu Jehová t'a winhaj Sansón chi', ix te och yip winh, ix st'inhchitanb'at chab' lasu chi' winh, icha tz'aj snhik'chajb'at junok k'apak k'apak tz'anak, ix em lanhnaj ch'anh t'a sk'ab' winh.
Elanhchamel ix yik'k'e jun sb'akil yalanh sti' nok' b'uru winh, yaxtakto wal jun b'ak chi'. Ha yet' jun b'ak chi', mil heb' winh filisteo chi' ix smak'cham winh.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan winh: Anhej jun sb'akil yalanh sti' nok' b'uru ix wak'lab'ej, kunhkunhb'a ix ajkan heb' chamnak wuuj. Yujnhej jun sb'akil yalanh sti' nok' b'uru, mil wal winak ix in mak'chamok, xchi winh.
Ixlajwi yalan jun chi' winh, ix sjulankanel jun sb'akil yalanh sti' nok' b'uru chi' winh. Yuj chi' a jun lugar chi', Ramat-lehi ix sb'iejkani, syalelk'ochi, “tzalan b'akil yalanh sti' nok' nok'”.

Ix te takji sti' winhaj Sansón chi', yuj chi' ix yawtej Jehová winh, ix yalan winh: --Ha ach ix ak' wip, yuj chi' ix wak' ganar heb' winh filisteo tik, palta ¿tom ol in a cha cham a in a chekab' in tik yuj takinhtial t'a yol sk'ab' juntzanh ch'ok chonhab'il tik? xchi winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix pak'k'eta jun ha ha' t'a Lehi chi' yuj Jehová. Ix yuk'an ha' winh, ix jax stzalajk'olal winh, ix te ochxi yip winh ix yab'i. Yuj chi', a jun a yune' ha' chi', En-hakore ix sb'iejkan ha', syalelk'ochi “yuk'b'ila' mach tz'awajk'ei”. Ha jun ha' chi', ix kannhej ha' t'a Lehi chi'.
Ha winhaj Sansón chi', 20 ab'il ix och winh yajalilok heb' israel chi', yakb'an ayoch heb' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' filisteo.
Ay jun k'ual, ix xit'ek' winhaj Sansón t'a Gaza. Hata' ix yil jun ix ajmul ix winh, ix och winh t'a yol spat ix, ix waykan winh yet' ix t'a jun ak'wal chi'.

Ayik ix yab'an heb' aj Gaza chi' to hata' ayek' winh, ix yoyan sb'a heb' t'a spatiktak pat chi', ix stanhwan spuertail chonhab' heb' t'a jun ak'wal chi'. Numan yaj heb', ix smaklan heb' yek' ak'wal chi'. Ix snaan heb' to ha t'a q'uinhib'alil t'a junxo k'u ol smilcham winh heb'.

Palta haxo winhaj Sansón chi', ix stanhwej winh yoch chimilak'wal, ix k'e waan winh. Ix b'at winh t'a spuertail chonhab' chi', ix schokanelta jun niwan puerta chi' winh yet' smarkoal. Ix sjolom jenhjab'an winh, ix b'at yak'ankan winh t'a jolom witz t'a yichanh Hebrón.
Ixlajwi chi', ix ochpax spensar winh t'a jun ix skuchan Dalila kajan t'a jun ch'olan skuch Sorec.

Yuj chi', ix b'at lolon heb' winh yajalil heb' filisteo yet' ix Dalila chi', ix yalan heb' winh t'a ix icha tik: --Tza montej wal winhaj Sansón chi', tza k'anb'an t'a winh b'ajtil skot jantak yip winh chi', tas wal skutej kak'an ganar winh ko tzek'ani, yik wach' maxtzak yal-laj skolan sb'a winh. Junjun onh ol kak' mil 100 siklo k'een plata t'ayach a tojolok, xchi heb' winh t'a ix.
Ix yalan ix t'a winhaj Sansón chi' icha tik: --Tzin tewi t'ayach, to tzal t'ayin b'ajtil skot jantak ip tik, ¿ay am wal tas tz'aj a tzek'ji yik maxtzak yal-laj a kolan a b'a? xchi ix t'a winh.
Ix tak'wi winh t'a ix icha tik: --Tato tzin tzek'chaj t'a ukeok ch'anh ch'anh manto junelok sk'anchaji, tz'el wip tik, icha yip junok komon anima tzin ajkani, xchi winh t'a ix.
Yuj chi', a heb' yajalil heb' filisteo chi' ix ik'anb'at uke' ch'anh ch'anh chi' t'a ix Dalila chi', ix stzek'an winhaj Sansón chi' ix.

Ay juntzanh heb' winh toxo ix sk'ub'ejel sb'a t'a yol spat ix chi', yuj chi' te chaanh ix el yaw ix: --Sansón, sjawi heb' winh filisteo ach smilchamok, xchi ix. T'a wal jun rato chi', ix st'inhchitanb'at juntzanh ch'anh ch'anh chi' winh. Icha sk'unal st'inhchaj junok anh ch'al tz'aeltak, icha chi' ix yutej ch'anh winh. Haxo heb' filisteo chi' maj nachajel-laj yuj heb' b'ajtil skot yip winh chi'.
Ix yalanxi ix t'a winh: --Te chuk ach, ix a musej wal in sat. Ix esej t'ayin. Ha tiknaik tzin tewi t'ayach to tzal t'ayin tas wal tz'aj a tzek'chaji, xchi ix.
Ix tak'wi winh icha tik: --Tato tzatz tzin utej a tzek'an yet' ch'anh lasu manta b'aj sk'anchaji, tz'el wip, icha yip junok komon anima tzin ajkani, xchi winh t'a ix.

Yuj chi', ix say juntzanh ch'anh lasu chi' ix, ix stzek'an winh ix t'a ch'anh. Ix elxi yaw ix: --Sansón, sjawi heb' winh filisteo ach smilchamok, xchi ix. Hanheja' t'a junelxo chi' ayxo heb' winh ix sk'ub'ejel sb'a t'a yol skuarto ix. Icha wal tz'aj st'inhchaj anh ch'al, icha chi' ix yutej ch'anh lasu chi' winh.

Ix yalanxi ix t'a winh icha tik: --Ichanhej tik in ixtani. Tzesejnhej t'ayin. Al wal t'ayin tas wal tz'aj ach ko tzek'ani, xchi ix. Ix tak'wi winh t'a ix: --Tato uke' tzutej a pach'uch'an xil in jolom jukan tik yet' anh ch'al, tzatz tzutejkanoch t'a te' jal-lab', tato icha chi', tz'elkan wip, icha wal yip junok komon anima tzin ajkani, xchi winh t'a ix. Ix b'oji way winh yuj ix. Ayik toxo ix way winh chi', ix sjalankanoch xil sjolom winh chi' ix yet' anh ch'al t'a te' jal-lab' chi'.
Ix stzatzb'itanem te' jal-lab' chi' ix, ix awaj ix: --Sansón, sjawi heb' winh filisteo ach smilchamok, xchi ix. Ix k'e juknaj winh, ix stok'ank'eta te jal-lab' chi' winh yet' anh ch'al chi'.
Yuj chi' ix yalan ix t'a winh icha tik: --Ha ach tik, te esalwum ach. ¿Tas yuj tzala' to tzin a xajanej? Yoxelalxo in ixtan tik. Manh jab'ok tzal t'ayin b'ajtil skot jantak ip tik, xchi ix.
Junjun k'u aynhejoch ijan ix sk'anb'an t'a winh b'ajtil skot yip winh chi', yuj chi' ix tzaktzajk'e winh yet' ix.

Yuj chi' ix yalelta winh, b'ajtil skot yip winh chi', ix yalan winh: --Manto junelok sjoxjiel xil in jolom yiktax in alji, yujto ayik manto in alji chi', ix in sik'jikanel yuj Dios yik tzin och nazareoal, syalelk'ochi to yiktaxon Dios waji. Yuj chi' tato ay mach sjoxanel xil in jolom tik, tz'elkan wip chi', icha junok komon anima tzin ajkani, xchi winh.

Ix nachajel yuj ix to a tiknaik yel syal winh. Ix yalanb'at ix t'a heb' winh yajalil heb' filisteo chi' icha tik: --Ha tiknaik, kotanhek t'a wal junelxo tik, toxo ix yalelta winh tas yuj te ay yip winh chi', xchi ix. Yuj chi' ix k'och heb' winh yil ix, yet'nak k'een tumin heb' winh.

Ix yak'an way winhaj Sansón chi' ix t'a sat xub', ix yawtan jun winh joxwajum ix. Haxo jun winh chi' ix joxanel uke' makan xil sjolom winh pach'uch'ab'il chi'. Icha chi' ix aj yel yip winh yuj ix, majxo yal skolan sb'a winh.

Ix awaj ix icha tik: --Sansón, sjawi heb' winh filisteo ach smilchamok, xchi ix. Ix el swayanh winh, am snaan winh to olto yal skolan sb'a winh ichataxon t'a juntak el. Manh yojtakok winh tato toxo ix aktajkan winh yuj Jehová.

Ixlajwi chi', ix ja heb' winh filisteo, ix stzek'an winh heb' winh, ix yik'ank'eta yol sat winh heb' winh, ix yik'anb'at winh heb' winh t'a chonhab' Gaza. Hata' ix yak'och k'een kadena nab'a bronke heb' winh t'a winh. Ix yak'anoch winh heb' winh t'a preso. Ix yak'anoch winh heb' winh munlajel t'a k'een jaxum trigo t'a yol preso chi'.
Palta haxo xil sjolom winh, ix syamxioch sq'uib'i.

Ix smolb'an sb'a heb' yajalil heb' filisteo t'a tzalajk'olal, yujto ix yamchaj winhaj Sansón yuj heb', ix yak'an silab' heb' t'a skomon diosal skuch Dagón, ix och ijan heb' sb'itan icha tik: Ha ko diosal tik ix ak'anoch winhaj Sansón t'a yol ko k'ab'. Haton jun winh kajk'ool, xchi heb'.

Hanheja' pax heb' anima, ayik ix yilanoch winhaj Sansón chi' heb', ix sb'itan sdiosal heb' icha tik: Ha ko diosal ix ak'anoch jun winh kajk'ol t'a yol ko k'ab', a winh nhusannaktz'a kawb'en. Tzijtum heb' ketchonhab' smak'nakcham winh, xchi heb'.

Ix te tzalaj heb' anima chi', ix sk'anankot winhaj Sansón chi' heb' yik smatz'an winh heb'. Ix yik'anelta winh heb' t'a yol preso, ix yak'anoch winh heb' t'a skal snanhal yoyal stemplo heb', yik syixtan winh heb'.
Ix yalan winh t'a jun winh kelem unin et'jinak: --Iq'uinb'at t'a yoyal snanhal yol templo tik, t'a juntzanh yipumal yaji yik tzin och ijan jab'ok t'ay, xchi winh.

Masanil heb' yajalil chonhab', molanek' heb' t'a yol templo chi', te b'ut'an yuj anima, heb' winh winak yet' heb' ix ix. Ay am oxe' milok anima ayk'e t'a schab'il piso, wan smatz'an heb' tas tz'utaj winhaj Sansón chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winh t'a Jehová: Ach in Dios Wajalil, tzin k'an t'ayach to tzin a nakot t'a junelxo tik, tzak'an wip yik tzin pakan in b'a t'a heb' winh filisteo tik, yujto ix yik'k'eta yol in sat heb' winh, xchi winh.
Ix och wetz'wetz' winh t'a chab' niwak yoyal templo chi' t'a snanhal yool, haton juntzanh kuchjinak yalil jun templo chi'.

Ix el yaw winh ix yalan winh: Junnhejokab' tz'aj in cham yet' heb' winh filisteo tik, xchi winh. Ixlajwi chi' ix yak'an yip winh yekan lanhchaj chab' niwak yoyal templo chi'. Ix kot lanhnaj templo chi' t'a yib'anh masanil heb' yajalil chonhab' chi' yet' t'a yib'anh masanil anima ayek' ta'. Ek'alto sb'isul anima ix cham yuj winh ayik ix cham winh chi' t'a yichanh heb' ix smak'cham winh ayik pitzanto.

Ixlajwi chi', ix k'och heb' yuk'tak winh yet' sk'ab' yok winh, ix b'at yik'ankot sniwanil winh chi' heb'. Ix smukan heb' t'a snanhal Zora yet' Estaol b'aj mukan winh smam winh, haton winhaj Manoa. Ha winhaj Sansón chi', 20 ab'il ix yak' yajalil winh t'a Israel.
Ha t'a tzalkixtak t'a yol yik heb' yinhtilal Efraín, hata' ek'nak kajan jun winh skuchan Micaía.

Ha jun winh chi', ix yal winh t'a ix snun icha tik: --Ayik ix elk'ajel k'een mil kien siklo plata t'ayach, ix a katab'ej jun elk'um chi'. Ix wab' halan juntzanh chi'. Palta a t'ayin ayek' k'een, a in ix welk'ej k'een t'ayach, xchi winh t'a ix snun chi'. Ix yalan ix snun winh chi' t'ay: --Yak'okab' swach'k'olal Jehová t'a ib'anh ach wune', xchi ix.

Ayik ix yak'anxi k'een winh t'a ix snun chi', ix yalan ix: --Ach wune', a tiknaik a k'een tumin tik, swak' k'een t'a Jehová, yik sb'oji junok komon Dios tzeyb'il yet' junok sb'oji t'a yol molde, yuj chi' a in swak'xi k'een t'ayach, xchi ix.

Palta ix yak'anxi k'een plata chi' winh t'a ix snun chi'. Ix yak'an 200 siklo k'een ix t'a jun winh b'oum plata chi', yik sb'oji juntzanh ix yal ix chi'. Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'anoch ix t'a yol spat winhaj Micaía chi'.
Ha spat winhaj Micaía chi', spatiltaxon komon Dios. B'ob'ilxo jun chaleka yik sakerdote yet' juntzanhxo yechel yuj winh. Haxo jun winh yuninal winh yak'nakxooch sakerdoteal.
Ha t'a jun pekti' chi', malaj sreyal heb' israel, yuj chi' junjun heb' sb'oan icha tas snib'ej.
Ha t'a chonhab' Belén t'a yol yik Judá, kajan jun winh kelem lewita.
Ix el winh t'a yol yik Belén chi', ix b'at winh say b'aj b'at kajnajok. Ix ek'nhej winh t'a tzalkixtak t'a yol yik Efraín, ix k'och winh t'a spat winhaj Micaía chi'.
--¿B'ajtil kajan ach? xchi winhaj Micaía chi' t'a winh. Ix yalan winh: --Ha t'a Belén t'a yol yik Judá ix in koti. Ha in tik lewita in, wan in sayanek' b'aj ol in kajnajok, xchi winh.

--Tato icha chi', kananh wet' t'a in pat tik, yik wach' tzach och in sakerdoteok, icha wal in mam ol ach ajok. Ol wak' lajunheok siklo plata a tojolok t'a junjun ab'il. Ol wak'anpax a pichul yet' a wael, xchi winhaj Micaía chi' t'a winh.
Ix schaan sk'ol winh skan kajan yet' winhaj Micaía chi', icha wal yuninal winh ix yutej winh.
Ix yak'anoch jun winh lewita chi' winh sakerdoteok, icha chi' ix aj skajnajkan winh yet' winh.
Ix snaan winhaj Micaía chi' to ol scha' swach'k'olal Jehová winh, yujto a jun winh lewita ayoch sakerdoteok winh.

Ha t'a jun pekti' chi', malaj sreyal heb' israel ayochi. Ha heb' yinhtilal Dan, mantalaj smakb'en heb' t'a skal heb' yetisraelal, yujto maj yik'ek'laj slum heb' ak'b'il t'ay, yuj chi' wan yek' heb' say b'aj skajnaji.

Yuj chi' ix schekb'at owanh heb' soldado heb' te tek'an, yik sb'at heb' sayoj lum b'aj skajnaji. Ix el heb' owanh chi' t'a chonhab' Zora yet' t'a Estaol, ix ek' heb' t'a tzalkixtak t'a yol yik Efraín, ix k'och heb' t'a spat winhaj Micaía chi'. Hata' ix kan heb' t'a jun ak'wal chi'.

Ayik wanxo sk'och heb' t'a slak'anil spat winhaj Micaía chi', ix yab'an heb' slolon winh kelem chi', ix yojtakejel heb' to ch'ok chonhab'il winh, ix b'at sk'anb'an heb' t'a winh icha tik: --¿Mach ach ik'ankot t'a tik? ¿Tas yuj ayachek' t'a tik? ¿Tas tzul a k'ulej? xchi heb' t'a winh.
Ix yalan winh t'a heb' yuj strato ix sb'o yet' winhaj Micaía chi', yik tz'och winh sakerdoteok winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan heb' t'a winh: --k'anb'ej t'a Dios kuuj, tato wach' ol aj yelk'och jun b'aj wan ko b'at tik, xchi heb' t'a winh.
Ix yalan winh t'a heb': --Junk'olal tzex b'ati, yujto scha sk'ol Jehová tas wan he k'ulan tik, xchi winh t'a heb'.

Yuj chi' ix b'atxi heb' owanh ilum lu'um chi', ix k'och heb' t'a chonhab' Lais. Ha heb' anima t'a jun chonhab' chi' te malaj tas sna heb', icha sb'eyb'al heb' sidonio. Ha heb' chi', ayek' heb' t'a tzalajk'olal yet' t'a junk'olal, malaj jab'ok tas syak' palta t'a heb', te najat skan chonhab' Sidón t'a heb', malaj mach ay yalan yik t'a heb', yik sb'a heb' sch'okoj.

Ixlajwi chi', ix meltzaj heb' ilum lum chi' t'a Zora yet' t'a Estaol, b'aj aykan juntzanhxo yetb'eyum heb'. Ix sk'anb'an heb' aykan chi' t'a heb' icha tik: --¿Tas ix aj b'aj ix ex ko chekb'at chi'? xchi heb'. Ix tak'wi heb' ilum lum chi':

--Ix ek' kil jun makan lum lum chi' smasanil, ix kila' to te wach' lu'um. Koyek, b'at kaq'ek owal yet' heb' kajan ta'. Malaj mach tonhej skan k'ojan t'a tik tato malaj jab'ok tas sk'ulej. Koyek kik'ek' jun lu'um chi'.
Ha heb' anima kajan ta', junk'olal yaj heb', te lewan lu'um, malaj tas syak' palta ta'. Ha Dios ol ak'an lum t'ayonh, xchi heb'.
Ay 600 heb' winh winak t'a yinhtilal Dan ix el t'a Zora yet' t'a Estaol chi', yet'nak yalyuninal junjun heb'. Te ay syamk'ab' heb' yik owal smasanil.
Ix k'och heb' t'a Quiriat-jearim t'a yol yik Judá. Ix sb'oank'e skampamento heb' t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u t'a Quiriat-jearim chi', haton jun lugar chi' skampamento winhaj Dan ix sb'iejkani.
Ix elxi heb' ta', ix ek' heb' t'a tzalkixtak t'a yol yik Efraín. Ix k'och heb' t'a slak'anil spat winhaj Micaía.

Ha heb' owanh xit'nakek' iloj lum t'a Lais chi', ix yal heb' t'a heb' yetb'eyum chi': --Ab'ek, ha t'a yol juntzanh pat tik ay jun chaleka yet' jun yechel tzeyb'il ayoch plata t'ay yet' jun komon Dios b'ob'il t'a yol molde. Ay pax juntzanhxo komon Dios. ¿Tas wal ol ko k'ulok yet'ok tze na'a? xchi heb'.
Ix b'at heb' owanh xit'nakek' iloj lum chi' b'aj kajan jun winh kelem lewita chi' t'a spat winhaj Micaía chi'. Ix k'och heb', ix sk'anb'an heb' janik' sk'ool winh.
Haxo heb' 600 soldado yinhtilal Dan chi', wan stanhwankan heb' t'a sti' puerta, yet'nak syamk'ab' heb' yik owal.

Haxo heb' owanh chi', ix k'e heb' t'a yol pat yik syik'anelta juntzanh tik heb': Jun yechel tzeyb'il, jun yechel b'ob'il t'a yol molde, jun chaleka yet' juntzanhxo kotak komon Dios. Ix yik'anelta juntzanh chi' heb' yakb'an ayek' winh sakerdote chi' yet' heb' 600 soldado chi' t'a ti' pat chi'.
Ayik ix yilan winh sakerdote chi' to ix och heb' chi' t'a yol spat winhaj Micaía chi' yik syik'anelta juntzanh tastak chi' heb', ix yalan winh: --¿Tas tze k'ulej chi'? xchi winh t'a heb'.

Ix yalan heb' t'a winh: --Tz'in xa chi, anhej to tzach b'at ket'ok. Sko nib'ej tzach och ko sakerdoteok, icha ko mam ol ach ajok. ¿Tom manh wach'ok tzab'i to tzach och sakerdoteal t'a junok makan yinhtilal Israel, t'a yichanh to anhej t'a junok patil anima? xchi heb'.
Ix scha sk'ol winh sakerdote tas ix yal heb' chi'. Ix yik'anek' juntzanh chi' winh t'a heb'. Ix och winh t'a skal heb', ix b'at winh yet' heb'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix b'atxi heb', b'ab'el heb' ix ix yet' heb' unin, nok' smolb'etzal nok' heb' yet' sk'ael heb'. Tzak'anxo ix b'at heb' soldado.
Najattakxo ix b'at heb', ichato chi' ix smolb'an sb'a winhaj Micaía yet' heb' yetchonhab', ix b'at heb' syam heb' yalani.

Haxo yik ix k'och heb' t'a spatik heb' ix awaj heb'. Haxo heb' yinhtilal Dan chi', ix meltzajkot k'elan heb', ix sk'anb'an heb' t'a winhaj Micaía chi': --¿Tas tzach ik'ani yuj chi' et'nak juntzanh anima tik? xchi heb'.

Ix tak'wi winh t'a heb': --Ha ex tik ix eyik'kot in diosal ix in b'o'o, ix eyik'anpaxkot winh in sakerdote, manhxo jab'ok tas ix eyaktejkan t'ayin, tze tek'b'an he b'a he k'anb'an t'ayin tas tzin ik'ani, xchi winh t'a heb'.
Ix yalan heb' t'a winh: --Malaj ko gana to sk'e a jaj awaj t'ayonh, yujto ha t'a ko kal tik ay heb' winh utzin sk'ool, haxo ta tz'aji tzach satel heb' winh yet' heb' ajun tik het'ok, xchi heb'.
Ayik ix yilan winhaj Micaía chi' to te niwan heb' t'a yichanh winh, ix meltzaj winh t'a spat. Haxo heb' yinhtilal Dan chi' ix b'atnhejkan heb' b'aj wan sb'at chi'.

Ix yik'anb'at juntzanh tastak sb'onak winhaj Micaía chi' heb' yet' winh sakerdote masanto ix k'och heb' t'a chonhab' Lais. Ha masanil heb' anima kajan t'a Lais chi', junk'olal yajek' heb', malaj tas sna' heb', yuj chi' te sekojtak ix aj satel heb', ix nhusjipaxtz'a schonhab' heb' chi' yuj heb' yinhtilal Dan chi'.

Ha chonhab' Lais chi', ha t'a yol yik Bet-rehob skani, te najatto ay t'a Sidón, malaj junok mach ay yalan yik t'a heb', yuj chi' malaj mach ix kolan heb'. Ha heb' yinhtilal Dan chi', ix sb'oxik'e jun chonhab' chi' heb', ix kajnaj heb' ta'.
Ha t'a yalanhtaxo, Lais sb'i jun chonhab' chi', haxo heb' ix ak'an sb'iej Dan, yik syak' b'inaj sb'i winh smam yicham heb', haton winhaj Dan yuninal winhaj Israel.

Hata' ix sb'ok'e jun yechel yet'nak heb' chi' yik tz'och heb' ejmelal t'ay. Haxo sakerdote heb', haton winhaj Jonatán yinhtilal Gersón yuninal winhaj Moisés. Ha heb' yinhtilal winhaj Jonatán chi', ix ochnhej heb' sakerdoteal t'a heb' yinhtilal Dan chi' masanto ayik ix ik'jib'at heb' israel t'a ch'ok chonhab'il.
Ha jun yechel ix sb'o winhaj Micaía chi', a ix och sdiosalok heb' yinhtilal Dan t'a masanil tiempo yakb'an ayek' skajnub' Dios t'a Silo.
Ayik mantalaj sreyal heb' israel, ay jun winh lewita najattak yajkanb'at t'a tzalkixtak t'a yol yik Efraín. Tonhej skomon b'eyek' winh. Ay jun ix aj Belén t'a yol yik Judá ix yik' winh.
Palta ix mulan ix t'a yol sk'ab' winh, yuj chi' ix pax ix t'a spat winh smam t'a Belén chi'. Ayik toxo ix el schanhil ujal yajek' ix ta',
ix k'ochxi winh lewita chi' smontejxi ix, talaj skotxi ix yet' winh. Yet'nak jun winh schekab' winh yet' chawanh nok' b'uru. Ix chaji winh yuj ix t'a spat winh smam chi'.

Hanhejtona' ix chajipax winh t'a tzalajk'olal yuj winh smam ix chi'. Ix yalan winh smam ix chi' to skan winh yet' heb'. Yuj chi' oxe' k'ual ix kan winh yet' winh schekab' chi' t'a spat winh smam ix chi'. Ix wa heb', ix yuk'an ha' heb', ix waypax heb' ta'.

Haxo t'a schanhil k'ual jun, ix k'e waan winh t'a q'uinhib'alil yik smeltzaj heb' winh yalani. Ayik wanxo smeltzaj heb' chi', ix yalan winh snhi' winh chi' t'ay: --Waek junok eyooch ichato chi' tzex b'ati yik wach' ay eyip ol ex b'eyok, xchi winh.
Yuj chi' ix em k'ojan heb' swa'i, ix yuk'an ha' heb', ix och tean winh snhi' winh chi' t'ay to skan junokxo ak'wal winh t'a tzalajk'olal.
Wach'chom ix k'e linhan winh yik smeltzaj winh snaani, palta ix ochxi tean winh snhi' winh chi' t'ay, yuj chi' ix kanxi winh.

Haxo t'a yoil k'ual jun, ix k'e waan winh t'a q'uinhib'alil yik smeltzaji, palta ix ochxi tean winh snhi' winh chi' t'ay yik swa'i, ichato chi' smeltzaj winh yik wach' ay yip winh sb'at t'a yoltak b'e. Ix wa heb' yakb'an wan sk'e k'u.

Haxo ix k'e waan winh yik smeltzaj heb' yalani. Ix yalanxi winh snhi' winh chi' t'ay to toxo ix k'e k'u, ix ochxi tean winh t'a winh yik skanxi winh t'a junxo ak'wal chi' t'a tzalajk'olal, haxo t'a junxo k'u, sakb'i sb'at heb'.

Palta haxo pax winh lewita chi', majxo yal-laj sk'ol winh ix kan t'a junxo ak'wal chi', palta ix meltzajxonhej winh yet' ix ix chi' yet' winh schekab' winh chi' yet' chawanh nok' sb'uru winh ayoch stz'uum. Ayik ix k'och heb' t'a yichanh Jebús, haton chonhab' Jerusalén, wanxo yem k'u.
Ix yalan winh chekab' chi' t'a winh lewita chi': --¿Tas am xa chi, tato tzonh kan t'a chonhab' Jebús tik t'a jun ak'wal tik? xchi winh.
Ix yalan winh lewita chi' icha tik: --Maay, max onh kanlaj wayanh t'a junok chonhab' to manhok heb' ketisraelal kajan t'ay. Ol onh b'atnhej masanto ol onh k'och t'a chonhab' Gabaa.
Ha t'a Gabaa chi' ol onh wayok, ma t'a Ramá, xchi winh.
Ix b'atnhej heb'. Wanxo sq'uik'b'i ix k'och heb' t'a Gabaa chi', t'a yol yik Benjamín.
Ix elkan heb' t'a yol b'e, ix b'atkan heb' t'a Gabaa. Hata' ol way heb' snaani. Ix b'at em k'ojan heb' t'a merkado t'a jun chonhab' chi', yujto malaj mach ix ak'an sposado heb'.

Haxo yik wanxo sk'e ak'wal ix ek' jun winh icham winak spetoj t'a smunlajel. Ha t'a tzalkixtak t'a yol yik Efraín ay schonhab' winh, palta kajan winh t'a Gabaa t'a skal heb' yinhtilal Benjamín t'a jun pekti' chi'.
Ayik ix yilanoch jun winh lewita chi' winh icham winak chi', ix sk'anb'an winh icha tik: --¿B'ajtil ex koti, b'ajpax tzex b'ati? xchi winh t'a winh.

Ix tak'wi winh lewita chi' icha tik: --Tonhej tzonh ek' t'a tik. Ko petoj t'a Belén. Wan ko pax t'a ko chonhab' najat t'a tzalkixtak t'a yol yik Efraín. Ix onh ek' jaye' k'ual t'a Belén chi', haxo tiknaik jun, wan ko b'at t'a skajnub' Jehová, palta malaj junok mach tz'ak'an ko posado t'a tik.
Ay yanh nok' in b'uru tik, ay pax ko wael yet' ix wetb'eyum tik yet' winh in chekab' tik. Malaj tas syak' palta t'ayonh, xchi winh.
Ix tak'wi winh icham winak chi' t'a winh: --Malaj tas tza na', a in ol wak' masanil tas ol och eyuj, max yal in k'ol tzex kan t'a merkado tik t'a t'ak'walil tik, xchi winh.
Yuj chi' ix yik'b'at heb' winh icham chi' t'a spat, ix yak'an swael nok' sb'uru winh chi' winh. Ixlajwi chi', ix sb'ikan yok heb', ix wa heb', ix yuk'an a heb'.

Yakb'an wan stzalaj heb', ix ja nhilnaj juntzanh heb' winh puch winak aj chonhab' chi' t'a spatiktak te' pat chi'. Ix och ijan heb' sponhub'tanhan och te' puerta chi', ix yalan heb' t'a winh icham winak chi': --Hak'uelta jun winh ix waykan chi' t'ayach. Ko gana skixtej winh, xchi heb' winh.
Ix elta winh aj pat chi', ix yalan winh t'a heb': --Maay ex wetanimail. Manh he na eyak' chukal chi' t'a jun winh anima ayek' posado tik t'ayin.

Ina jun ix wisil kob'esto yet' pax jun ix ix yet'nak jun winh winak tik. Ha heb' ix tik, syal wak'anel heb' ix t'ayex yik tze k'ulan tas he gana chi' t'a heb' ix, palta manh he k'ulej chukal chi' t'a jun winh tik, xchi winh.

Palta maj schalaj yab' heb' winh tas ix yal winh icham winak chi'. Ix spechanelta ix yetb'eyum winh lewita chi' t'a yol kalle. Ix yixtan ix heb' winh ix ek' ak'wal, masanto ix sakb'i, ichato chi' ix yaktankan ix heb' winh.
Wanxo sakb'i, ix b'at ix t'a spat winh icham winak b'aj ayek' winh yetb'eyum chi', haxo yik k'och ix t'a ti' pat chi', ix telwi ix, ix cham ix.

Ayik ix k'e waan winh lewita chi' t'a q'uinhib'alil, ix sjakan spuertail te' pat chi' winh yik smeltzaji. Ix yilan winh, pak'jab'ek' ix yetb'eyum winh chi' t'a ti' pat chi', jichankanb'at sk'ab' ix t'a yib'anh smarkoal sti' te' pat chi'.
Ix yalan winh t'a ix: --Q'ueanh waan, konh, xchi winh t'a ix. Palta majxo tak'woklaj ix. Ix yik'ank'e wan sniwanil ix chi' winh, ix yak'ank'e winh t'a yib'anh nok' b'uru, ix yik'anb'at winh t'a spat.
Ayik ix k'och winh t'a spat chi', ix xikanb'at sniwanil ix yetb'eyum winh chi'. Lajchawe' ix yutej winh xikanb'ati. Ix laj yak'anb'at winh t'a masanil yol smakb'en heb' yetisraelal.
Ha masanil heb' ix ilan jun chi', ix yalan heb': --Yiktax kelnakkot t'a Egipto, mantalaj b'aj ix kil junok icha jun tik. Yowalil scham wal ko naanek tas ol ko k'ulejek yet'ok, xchi heb'.

Yuj chi' ix smolb'an sb'a masanil heb' israel t'a yichanh Jehová t'a Mizpa, junxonhej ix yutej spensar heb'. Ix kot heb' ay t'a yol smakb'en heb' yinhtilal Dan t'a norte, heb' ay t'a Beerseba t'a sur yet' heb' ay t'a Galaad t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u.
Masanil heb' yajal yaj t'a junjun yinhtilal heb' israel schonhab' Dios, ayek' molan heb' ta'. Ay am 400 mil heb' soldado yet'nakxo syamk'ab' yik owal.

(Ix yab' spekal heb' yinhtilal Benjamín to ix smolb'ej sb'a heb' yetisraelal heb' t'a Mizpa.) Haxo heb' yajalil heb' israel chi' ix halani, tato ay heb' ojtannak tas ix aj yuji jun chukal chi', syal yalan heb'.
Haxo winh yetb'eyum ix chamnak chi' ix halani: --Ix in jawi yet' ix wetb'eyum chi' t'a chonhab' Gabaa t'a yol yik Benjamín yik tzin waykan ta'.

Haxo t'a jun ak'wal chi', ix smolb'ej sb'a heb' winh winak ay t'a jun chonhab' chi' t'a spatiktak te' pat b'aj ay in ek' chi', yik tzin smilancham heb' winh yalani. Ix och ijan heb' winh yixtan ix wetb'eyum chi', masanto ix cham ix yuj heb' winh.
Yuj chi' ix wik'kot sniwanil ix chi', ix in xikanb'ati. Ix wak'anb'at t'a masanil yol ko makb'en, yik wach' tzeyil he masanil tas ix aj yoch jun niwan mul te chukxo pax tik.
Haxo tiknaik yujto wetisraelal ex, a ex ol he na'a, ol eyala' tas ol aj jun tik, xchi winh.
Junxonhej ix yutej spensar heb' smasanil, ix yalan heb' icha tik: --Malaj junok onh tzonh pax t'a ko pat masanto ol yal sb'a tas ol aj jun tik.
Ha tiknaik a tas sko k'ulej to tz'och suerte t'a ko kal yik wach' ol kila' mach onh ol onh b'at kak' owal t'a chonhab' Gabaa chi'.

Junjun winak t'a skal lajlajunhwanh winak t'a junjun inhtilal skan t'a yib'anh sayan ko wael a onh soldado onh tik. Ha onhxo ko masanil, ol onh b'at kak'ek' spak t'a heb' aj Gabaa yuj jun chukal ix sk'ulej heb' chi', xchi heb'.
Junxonhej ix yutej sb'a heb' israel chi' yik ix b'at heb' yak' owal t'a jun chonhab' chi'.
Ix yak'anb'at schekab' heb' t'a masanil yol yik Benjamín. Ix ek' yalan heb' icha tik: Yelxo wal te chuk tas ix sk'ulej jaywanh heb' winak aj Gabaa.

Yuj chi' a tiknaik, a juntzanh winak ix k'ulan chukal t'a he kal chi', ik'ekelta heb', tzeyak'anoch heb' t'a yol ko k'ab' yik sko milancham heb', icha chi' ol aj satel jun chukal chi' t'a ko kal a onh israel onh tik, xchi heb'. Maj schalaj yab' heb' yinhtilal Benjamín chi'.
Palta to ix smolb'ej sb'a heb' soldado heb' t'a Gabaa chi' yik syak'an owal heb' yet' juntzanhxo heb' yetisraelal chi'.
Ay am 26 mil heb' soldado ix kot t'a juntzanh chonhab' t'a yol yik Benjamín chi', yet'nak syamk'ab' heb' yik owal. Ch'ok pax yaj 700 heb' soldado te jelan, aj Gabaa chi' heb'.
Ha t'a skal masanil heb' soldado chi', 700 heb' to ha t'a sk'exanh sjulwaj yet' ch'anh mejmeech. Te tojol sjulwaj heb', wach'chom a junok tas te xi' sjul heb', palta syamchaj yuj heb'.
Haxo pax juntzanhxo heb' israel chi', ay am 400 mil heb' soldado te k'ajan t'a owal, malaj heb' aj Benjamín chi' t'a skal heb'.

Ix b'at heb' israel chi' b'aj ayek' skajnub' Dios yik sk'anb'an heb' mach inhtilal heb' sb'ab'laj och yak' owal yet' heb' yinhtilal Benjamín chi'. Ix yalan Jehová to a heb' yinhtilal Judá sb'ab'laj ochi.
Ix k'e waan heb' israel chi' t'a q'uinhib'alil, ix b'at sb'oank'e skampamento heb' t'a yichanh chonhab' Gabaa chi'.
Ix sb'oanoch sb'a heb' t'a yichanh chonhab' chi' yik syak'an owal heb'.
Haxo heb' yinhtilal Benjamín chi', ix elta heb' t'a yol chonhab' chi'. Ha t'a jun k'u chi', 22 mil heb' yetisraelal heb' chi' ix smilchamok.

Yuj chi' ix b'at heb' israel chi' t'a yichanh Jehová, kusk'olal yaj heb' ix ek' k'u, masanto ix k'ik'b'iemi. Ixlajwi chi' ix sk'anb'an heb' t'a Jehová: ¿Tzam onh b'atxi kak' owal yet' heb' ketisraelal yinhtilal Benjamín? xchi heb'. Ix yalan Jehová: Ixikek, xchi t'a heb'. Yuj chi' ix yik'anxi yip heb', haxo t'a junxo k'u ix b'at heb' yak'xi owal yet' heb' yinhtilal Benjamín chi'. Hanheja' b'aj ix och heb' t'a sb'ab'elal, hata' ix ochxi heb'.
Hanheja' t'a junelxo chi', ix elixta heb' yinhtilal Benjamín chi' yak' owal yet' heb'. 18 mil soldado yetisraelal heb' chi' ix smilchamok.

Yuj chi', ix b'atxi heb' soldado smasanil yet' masanil heb' chonhab' t'a skajnub' Dios. Ix ochxi heb' t'a kusk'olal t'a yichanh Jehová. Pilan k'u maj wa jab'ok heb'. Ix snhusan silab' heb', ix yak'anpax silab' heb' yik junk'olal.

Ha t'a jun pekti' chi', a te' skaxail strato Jehová, ayek' te' t'a skajnub' Dios chi'. Ha winhaj Finees yuninal winhaj Eleazar, yixchikin winhaj Aarón ayoch sakerdoteal. Ix sk'anb'an heb' israel chi' t'a Jehová tato syal yak'anxi owal chi' heb' yet' heb' yinhtilal Benjamín chi', mato manhxo. Ix yalan Jehová t'a heb': Hak'ek owal yet' heb', a k'ik'an swak'och heb' t'a yol he k'ab', xchi t'a heb'.
Yuj chi' ix b'at juntzanh heb' soldado yik Israel sk'ub'ejel sb'a t'a spatiktak chonhab' Gabaa chi'.

Haxo juntzanhxo heb', ix b'at heb' yak' owal yet' heb' soldado yik Benjamín chi'. Ix sb'oanoch sb'a heb' yik syak'an owal heb' yet' heb' aj Gabaa chi', icha ix yutej sb'a heb' t'a sb'ab'elal yet' t'a schaelal.

Ix elixta heb' yik Benjamín chi' t'a yol chonhab' chi' yak' owal yet' heb'. Najat ix kot heb' yak' owal yet' heb' yetisraelal chi'. Ix to wal yak' ganar heb' smilancham 30-xo heb' israel t'a yol sb'eal Betel yet' t'a yol sb'eal Gabaa yet' b'aj manhxa mach kajan.

Ha wal snaan heb' to wan yel heb' yetisraelal heb' chi' t'ay, wan yak'an ganar heb' snaani, icha ix yak' heb' t'a sb'ab'elal yet' t'a schaelal, palta tonhej ix stz'akel sb'a heb' soldado israel chi', yakb'an wan skot heb' t'a yoltak b'e najat t'a stiel chonhab'.
Ayik ix k'och heb' israel chi' t'a slak'anil Baal-tamar, elanhchamel ix sb'oxioch sb'a heb' yak' owal chi'. Ix elpaxkot heb' ix sk'ub'ejel sb'a t'a spatiktak chonhab' Gabaa chi'.

Lajunhe' mil heb' sik'b'ilel t'a skal masanil soldado yik Israel ix och t'a chonhab' chi' yak' owal, yelk'olal ix te och yip owal chi'. Ha heb' yik Benjamín najat ix b'at chi', max snalaj heb' tato wan satel heb'.

Yuj Jehová ix yak' ganar heb' israel chi' t'a heb' yik Benjamín chi'. Ha t'a jun k'u chi', 25 mil yet' 100-xo heb' yinhtilal Benjamín chi' ix chami. Ichato chi' ix yilanelta sb'a heb' to wan yak'ji ganar heb'.

Icha tik ix aj yoch owal chi'. Ha t'a sb'ab'elal, a heb' soldado israel chi' najat ix el heb' t'a yichanh heb' yik Benjamín chi', yujto yipk'olal yaj heb' winh ix sk'ub'ejel sb'a t'a spatiktak chonhab' Gabaa chi', yik satel jun chonhab' chi' heb'.
Haxo heb' soldado ix sk'ub'ejel sb'a chi', elanhchamel ix och heb' t'a yol chonhab' chi', ix smilancham masanil heb' anima chi' heb'.

Ha heb' ix sk'ub'ejkanel sb'a chi', lajti' yaj heb' yet' heb' soldado yetb'eyum heb' to ayik ol och heb' t'a yol chonhab' chi', ol yak' cheklaj k'e stab'il heb', yik wach' snachajel yuj heb' chi' to toxo ix yak' ganar jun chonhab' chi' heb'.

Ha wal yik wan yel heb' israel t'a heb' yinhtilal Benjamín chi', ix yilan jun niwan tab' chi' heb', yuj chi' ix meltzaj heb', ix stek'b'an sb'a heb' t'a yichanh heb' yinhtilal Benjamín chi'. Toxo ix cham 30 heb' yuj heb' yik Benjamín chi', yuj chi' ix sna' heb' yik Benjamín chi' to wan yak'an ganar heb', icha ix yak' heb' t'a sb'ab'elal.
Ha wal t'a jun rato chi' ix k'e juyuyok tab' t'a chonhab' chi'. Ayik ix yilanb'at heb' yik Benjamín chi' t'a spatik, juyuyi sk'e stab'il schonhab' heb' chi' t'a chaanh.
Icha wal chi' ix aj stek'b'an sb'a heb' israel t'a yichanh heb' yik Benjamín chi', ix te xiwk'e heb' yik Benjamín chi', ix nachajel yuj heb' to wan yak'ji ganar heb'.

Yuj chi' ix el lemnaj heb' t'a yichanh heb' israel chi', ix b'atkan heb' b'aj sb'atkan sb'eal tzinan lu'um, palta maxtzak yal-laj yel heb' yujto ix yamji heb'. Ix miljicham heb' yuj heb' israel tz'elta t'a yol schonhab' heb' chi'.
Ix oymaj heb' israel chi' t'a spatiktak heb'. Icha wal chi' ix aj yak'ji ganar heb' smasanil, ix pechji heb' yuj heb' b'aj syik' yip heb' anima masanto t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u t'a Gabaa chi'
Hata' ix cham 18 mil heb' yinhtilal Benjamín chi'.

Haxo juntzanhxo heb', ix b'at heb' elelal t'a tzinan lu'um t'a stojolal k'een tenam skuch Rimón, palta oye' mil heb' chi' ix cham t'a yoltak b'e. Ix ochnhej heb' israel chi' t'a spatik heb' ixto kan chi', masanto t'a Gidom. Ix ak'ji ganar heb' yuj heb' israel chi'. Chab'to mil heb' soldado chi' ix cham yuj heb' israel chi'.
Yuj chi' ha t'a jun k'u chi', 25 mil heb' soldado yik Benjamín chi' ix chami, haton heb' soldado te jelan t'a owal.
Palta 600 to heb' winh ix b'atkan elelal t'a tzinan lu'um. Chanhe' ujal ix aj heb' winh t'a k'een tenam skuchan Rimón chi'.

Haxo heb' israel ix b'at heb' t'a masanil chonhab' t'a yol yik Benjamín chi', ix xikancham masanil anima heb' yet' masanil nok' molb'etzal nok'. Ix snhusanpaxtz'a junjun chonhab' heb' yet' masanil tastak ay t'ay.
Ha masanil heb' israel chi', ix yak' sti' heb' t'a yichanh Jehová t'a Mizpa to malaj junok heb' ol yak' yisil yetb'eyumok heb' yinhtilal Benjamín.
Ayik ix lajwi owal chi', ix smolan sb'a heb' israel chi' t'a yichanh Dios t'a skajnub', masanto ix k'ik'b'i, ix ok' wal heb' sik'lab'il, ix yalan heb':
Mamin Jehová ko Diosal ach, ¿tas wal yuj ix jawi jun tik t'a kib'anh? ¿Tas wal yuj wan satel jun kinhtilal a onh israel onh tik? xchi heb'.
Haxo t'a junxo k'u, ix k'e waan heb', ix sb'oank'e jun altar heb', ix snhusantz'a silab' heb' t'a yichanh Jehová, ix yak'anpax silab' heb' yik junk'olal.

Ix och ijan heb' sk'anb'an yab'i: ¿Mach heb' ketchonhab' maj xit'ek' ket'ok t'a molchajel t'a yichanh Jehová t'a Mizpa? xchi heb'. Yujto yak'nak sti' heb', tato ay mach max b'at t'a jun molchajel chi', smiljichamok.
Te kusk'olal yaj heb' yuj tas ix sk'ulej heb' yet' heb' yetisraelal yinhtilal Benjamín chi'. Ix och ijan heb' yalani: Ha wal t'a jun k'u tik ix satel jun inhtilal t'a ko kal.
¿Tas wach' sko k'ulej yik tz'ochxi yetb'eyum heb' winh ixto kan chi'? Ha onh tik ix kak' ko ti' t'a yichanh Jehová to malaj junok onh ol kak' heb' ix kisil yetb'eyumok heb' winh.

¿Ay am heb' ketisraelal maj xit'ek' ket'ok t'a Mizpa molchajel t'a yichanh Jehová? xchi heb'. Haxo ix snaankot heb' to a heb' kajan t'a Jabes t'a yol yik Galaad, malaj junok heb' ix xit'ek' t'a molchajel chi'.
Ayik ix awtaj lista, malaj junok heb' aj Jabes chi' ix tak'wi.

Ayik ix yab'an jun chi' heb' chonhab' smasanil, ix schekanb'at 12 mil soldado heb', yik b'at miljicham masanil heb' aj Jabes chi', masanil heb' winak, heb' unin yet' masanil heb' ix ix ayxo winak sk'umej.
Ha t'a skal masanil heb' aj Jabes chi', ix ilchaj 400 heb' ix kob'estak mantalaj winak tzek' t'a spatik, ix ik'jikot heb' ix t'a kampamento t'a Silo t'a yol yik Canaán.

Ixlajwi chi', masanil heb' chonhab' chi', ix schekb'at yalumal heb' t'a heb' winh yinhtilal Benjamín aykanb'at sk'ub'ejel sb'a t'a k'een tenam skuchan Rimón, ix b'at ik'chajkot heb' winh t'a junk'olal.
Yuj chi' ix meltzajkot heb' winh aj Benjamín chi'. Haxo heb' israel ix ak'an heb' ix kob'estak ix yik'kot heb' t'a Jabes chi' yetb'eyumok heb'. Palta ayto maj tz'akwok yik'an yetb'eyum heb' smasanil.
Ha masanil heb' israel chi' ix ok' sk'ol heb' yuj heb' yinhtilal Benjamín chi', yujto ix satjiel jun inhtilal chi' yuj Jehová.

Haxo heb' yajal yaj t'a kal chonhab' chi' ix sk'anb'ej heb' icha tik: ¿Tas wal ol aj yilchajpax heb' ix yetb'eyum juntzanhxo heb' winh ix kan tik, yujto masanil heb' ix yetb'eyum heb' winh, ix cham heb' ix smasanil?
Ha yuj juntzanh heb' winh ixto kan chi', yuj chi' olto pitzwokchaanh jun inhtilal tik, yik max satel t'a ko kal a onh israel onh tik.

Palta a onh tik, max yal-laj kak'an heb' ix kisil yik tz'och yetb'eyumok heb' winh, yujto ko masanil ix kak' ko ti' t'a yichanh Dios to max kak'laj heb' ix kisil t'a heb' winh, yuj chi' a mach syak' yisil, skotkan katab' t'a yib'anh.

Palta junjun ab'il ay jun niwan q'uinh tz'och t'a yichanh Jehová t'a Silo, haton jun ay t'a snorteal Betel, t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u t'a b'e sb'at t'a Betel chi' sk'och t'a Siquem, t'a stojolal sur yik Lebona, xchi heb'.
Ha heb' yajal yaj t'a skal heb' israel chi', ix yalb'at jun lolonel tik heb' t'a heb' yinhtilal Benjamín chi': Tzex b'at he k'ub'ejel he b'a t'a skaltak te' uwa t'a slak'anil Silo.

Wach' tzeyutej he k'ub'anel he b'a ta', lista eyaji. Ayik ol eyilan yelta nhililok heb' ix kob'estak aj Silo chanhal ta', tzex elta b'aj k'ub'an ex chi', tzeyik'ankot junjunok heb' ix eyetb'eyumok. Slajwi chi' tzex paxkan t'a he chonhab'.

Tato ol jawok heb' winh smam, ma heb' winh snulej heb' ix kob'estak chi' yal t'ayonh, ol kalan t'a heb': Sko k'an niwank'olal t'ayex t'a spatik heb' winh, yujto maj ilchaj yetb'eyum heb' winh smasanil kuuj, ayik ix och owal t'a Jabes. Hanhejtona', tik wal manhok ex ix eyak' heb' ix t'a heb' winh, yuj chi' max ochlaj he mul b'aj ix eyak' he ti', xko cham t'a heb', xchi heb' yajalil Israel chi'.

Ix schaan sk'ol heb' winh yik Benjamín chi' sk'ulan icha ix alchaj chi'. Yuj chi' junjun heb' winh ix yik'b'at junjun heb' ix kob'estak chi' ayik wan schanhalwi heb' ix. Ix yik'anb'at heb' ix heb' winh t'a elanhchamel t'a schonhab', ix sb'oanxik'e schonhab' heb' winh chi' yik skajnajxi heb' winh ta'.
Hanheja' juntzanhxo heb' winh yetisraelal heb' winh chi', ix meltzajpax junjun heb' winh t'a sluum yet' t'a spat.
Ha t'a jun pekti' chi' mantalaj sreyal heb' israel, junjun heb' sk'ulej icha tas snib'ej.
